data.body: Duplicate of subsolar-sonorous-puppy (in progress). Same test, test_benchmark_commit_count_is_ceil_per_pass. The worker crash is how this suite reports a timeout: pytest-timeout runs with timeout_method=thread, and on expiry calls os._exit(1) inside the xdist worker, so an over-budget test shows as 'Not properly terminated' with no traceback (root-caused in uneducated-conveyable-nabarlek, Gerrit 3293; the reporting gap is filed as delighted-worthless-foal). subsolar-sonorous-puppy measured this test at 302-537 s against the 300 s limit under load and is fixing its per-comment git cost. This run's 3-5 min standalone timings fit that.
